title: Great subscription for a good price!
text: The full sized peach and lily glass serum alone made this box worth its $15 plus tax price! The combination of this serum and the osea ocean cleanser from the July allure box has made my skin nice and smooth! The lip and cheek balm is another great item. It impart a pretty peachy natural looking flush. I also love the acne patches. They are infused with acne healing ingredients like tea tree, centella, and calendula oil. I’m very pleased with this box and the ease of subscribing through Amazon. It’s easy to skip a month or cancel (if you want to but I think this subscription is a great deal!)
label: positive
